stem.text: In a high-wire circus act, a man of mass $85\,\text{kg}$ is standing at rest at the midpoint of the wire.

stem.alt: Wire stretched between two blocks, with a person standing at its lowest point; angles of 20° marked at each block and tension labelled T on each side of the person.

stem.text: The wire on either side of the man is at an angle of $20^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.
What is the tension $T$ in the wire?
